examples.description: Transcribe an English voiceover asset into captions

description: [$0.0043/min at provider cost] Transcribe an audio or video asset into word-timed captions. REPLACES every previously transcribed caption on this project; captions you wrote by hand survive. Speaker labels are asked for: a row carries speaker (Speaker 1, Speaker 2, ...) only when the recognizer labelled its words, and the reply's speaker_count is 0 when it labelled none. Read the rows with get_transcript; follow with remove_fillers / remove_silence to clean the transcript.
